inputs.resume_text:
VIKRAM SINGH RATHORE
PGP 2025-27, Indian Institute of Management Indore | vikram.rathore@iimidr.ac.in

EDUCATION
PGP, IIM Indore, 2025-27, CGPA 7.4/10 (Term 1-3)
B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering, Military College of Electronics and Mechanical Engineering (JNU), 2017, 7.9/10

WORK EXPERIENCE (60 months)
Indian Army, Corps of EME, Captain | Jun 2018 - May 2023
- Commanded a 120-member Light Repair Workshop supporting an armoured regiment in Rajasthan
- Cut average vehicle turnaround time from 9 days to 5 days by redesigning the spares indent cycle and setting up a forward spares cell
- Managed spares inventory worth INR 14 crore across 3 depots; brought audit discrepancies down to zero in two consecutive annual audits
- Led recovery of 22 vehicles during a flash flood exercise in Barmer with no casualties
Indian Army, Lieutenant | Jun 2017 - May 2018
- Officer-in-charge of a training cadre of 40 craftsmen
Career note: Jun 2023 - Jun 2025, prepared for CAT and worked as a volunteer instructor at a veterans' skilling centre in Jaipur

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Tata Steel, Kalinganagar | Operations Intern | Apr - Jun 2026
- Built a criticality-based spares stocking model for 312 hot strip mill spares; projected INR 3.2 crore reduction in inventory holding with no rise in breakdown risk
- Mapped the breakdown-to-repair process across 4 departments and proposed a single work-order queue; adopted for the cold rolling mill pilot
- Received Pre-Placement Interview (PPI)

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Member, Operations Club (OpsCom), IIM Indore: organised Supply Chain Summit with 9 industry speakers
- Sports Secretary, Officers' Mess, 2021-22

ACHIEVEMENTS
- Chief of Army Staff Commendation Card, 2022
- National finalist, Mahindra War Room 2025 (top 8 of 1,100 teams)

plan.warmup_question: What first drew you to operations and supply chain work?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career so far, with a focus on your last couple of roles.

slots.core_question: What were you trying to solve when you built the criticality-based spares stocking model at Tata Steel?
slots.intent_private: Needs Vikram's specific problem definition, his personal modelling choices, the trade-off between inventory and breakdown risk, and how the projected INR 3.2 crore reduction was calculated; because this was a completed summer internship, also needs what he would do differently now.
likely_probes: What part of the stocking model did you personally build?
Why did you choose criticality as the basis for stocking?
What would you do differently if you rebuilt the model today?

slots.core_question: Walk me through how you reduced vehicle turnaround time in the Army.
slots.intent_private: Needs the starting constraint, Vikram's specific decisions in redesigning the spares indent cycle and forward spares cell, the stakeholders affected, and evidence supporting the reduction from 9 days to 5 days.
likely_probes: What decision did you personally make first?
What did you change in the spares indent cycle?
What was the turnaround time before the change?

slots.core_question: How did the Supply Chain Summit come about in the Operations Club at IIM Indore?
slots.intent_private: Needs Vikram's individual contribution to organising the summit, how he coordinated with speakers and teammates, and how he handled a concrete execution challenge.
likely_probes: What part of organising the summit did you personally own?
What was the hardest coordination decision you had to make?
How many industry speakers took part?

slots.core_question: What did you have to figure out first when managing spares inventory across the Army's three depots?
slots.intent_private: Needs Vikram's approach to controlling INR 14 crore of inventory, the decisions behind the controls he introduced, how depot stakeholders responded, and how he verified zero discrepancies across two audits.
likely_probes: What inventory problem did you address first?
Which control did you decide to introduce?
What was the value of inventory under your responsibility?

plan.plan_notes: The plan focuses on Vikram's unusually strong operations, inventory and process-improvement evidence, while testing both his Tata Steel internship claims and the scale of his Army responsibility. The Operations Club slot preserves coverage of a substantive MBA activity, and the resume does not show a material gap or mismatch requiring a separate concern slot.
